_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.52.0 (join on ids inside a JSON array; masking applies to output only); beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.71.0 (query time in the results; access policies renamed masking policies). beamlynx-ui 0.71.0 still needs pine-lang 0.51 (its RequiredVersion).
